item.description:
Artist: Britney Spears
Album: Original Doll
Year: 2005
Genre: Pop
Quality: Flac 16-24bits/44-48.1kHz
Source: Apple Music / Curtains (filipecroft2022) / thaliszito
Size : 401mb

Tracklist
  • 01 My Prerogative [24bit]
  • 02 (I've Just Begun) Having My Fun [24bit]
  • 03 Chaotic [16bit]
  • 04 Rockstar (Remastered) [24bit]
  • 05 Do Somethin' [24bit]
  • 06 Mona Lisa [16bit]
  • 07 Over to You Now [16bit]
  • 08 And Then We Kiss (Junkie XL Remix) [16bit]
  • 09 Strangest Love (Remastered) [24bit]
  • 10 You Can't Stop What You Can't Stop [16bit]
  • 11 Someday (I Will Understand) [16bit]
  • 12 Sippin' On (Remastered - Bonus Track) [24bit]

Note: Hi, everyone! Well, I know you’ve probably already seen dozens of fan-made versions of the “Originall Doll” urban legend, but I’d still like to share “my version.” I gathered some of the best songs from the period between 2003 and 2005 (some released, others not) in the best quality I could find, from both official and unofficial sources, and put together this tracklist in the order that makes the most sense to me and that I consider most coherent.
I also designed a cover featuring a very “IT girl” photo of her, taken around the same time as some of the songs, which I think captures the vibe of some of the tracks.

Btw, I’d like to emphasize that I don’t want to take credit for anyone else’s work—this is just something I wanted to share from one fan to other fans.

**If anyone has “24-bit” versions of the “16-bit” tracks and would like to share them, I’d be very happy.**

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/127ZUrXbmIbbZVLWp4xqd6YuEziQ1QJuI?usp=sharing
